name: contract-history-retention
goal: Rebuild complete source history without retaining full revision source state or corrupting shared-tree catalog measurement provenance

evidence: Full 2873-revision reconstruction retained about 6 GB after only 42 revisions. A strengthened existing archive case additionally checks that two commits sharing a tree retain their own catalog measurement revision.

The existing archive case covered only two different trees and verified JSON/media, not the SQLite catalog measurement provenance. Extend that same case with an unchanged-tree commit and exact selected-revision assertions; keep one case.
